channel.title: Latest AI News — AIBase
channel.description: Comprehensive coverage of AI headlines: model releases, product updates, research breakthroughs, and industry shifts.

item.title: Runway Open-Sources 27B World Action Model Praxis-1: Tops Authoritative Robotics Leaderboard, Fully Supports Apache 2.0 Commercial Open Source
item.description: Runway open-sources its flagship world action model Praxis-1 under the Apache 2.0 license, releasing all model weights along with inference and fine-tuning code, and supporting commercial use. It is regarded as a new milestone in embodied intelligence competition. The model has 27 billion parameters, adopts a Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Transformer architecture, and tops an authoritative robotics leaderboard, demonstrating top-tier performance.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Robin Li: AI transformation is more than a technological revolution; companies need to restructure their organizations around AI agents
item.description: Nov 12: Li Yanhong told Baidu World 2026 that AI is both a tech and organizational revolution; intelligent organizations will be the AI era's "new factory" in the next decade. In 2016 he called AI "the new computer"; today AI spans GPUs, chips, cloud, models and agent-centric apps.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Claude API Adds a Gear: Mid-Chat, You Can Temporarily Boost the AI
item.description: Nov 12, Anthropic added a Beta feature to Claude API: developers can adjust effort levels mid-conversation to balance response depth, speed, and cost. Switching requires no new session, cache stays intact—just insert a blank system message, breaking the fixed-parameter-per-session limit.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Baidu launches large model trading platform Ciyuansuo: claims to be neutral and trustworthy, aims to build the stock exchange of the large model industry
item.description: At Baidu World 2026, Robin Li launched Ciyuan Suo, a large-model service platform. Inspired by stock exchanges, it tackles choice overload and trust issues, aiming to be a neutral, trusted hub for model trading and distribution, serving developers and businesses.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: AI Office Competition Shifts from Model Capabilities to Cost and Choice: Doubao Work Opens Third-Party Model Access
item.description: Doubao's Nov 12 update adds third-party models Kimi K3.1Pro, GLM5.3, and DeepSeek V4.1Flash alongside its Doubao 2.1 Lite and Pro, plus a limited-time offer. The selection page shows quota consumption multipliers—lower means less cost—letting users weigh task complexity, speed, and value, turning model differences into quantifiable costs for easier decisions.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Alibaba Makes Major Official Announcement of Qwen4 Large Model: Core Capabilities Upgraded Across the Board; Qwen App Now Fully Integrated with Preview Version
item.description: Alibaba says its next-gen Qwen4 LLM will launch soon, featuring a new core architecture, major performance gains, stronger knowledge understanding, broader semantic parsing, and better handling of complex contexts.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Tencent denies rumors of 50% layoffs: plans to invest half of its resources in AI Native exploration
item.description: Tencent PR director Zhang Jun denied rumors of 50% layoffs on Nov 12, calling them false. Tencent is accelerating organizational change for the AI era—not cost-cutting—to boost efficiency and innovation, with flatter middle management and frontline teams seeking new business/value.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Domestic Seismic Large Model DiTing Debuts: Gathering 20 Million Datasets to Let AI Understand the Earth's Heartbeat
item.description: AI achieves breakthroughs in research and disaster prevention. In 2026, the "New Journey in Emergency Response" interview tour visited the National Key Laboratory of Earthquake Dynamics and Strong Earthquake Prediction, where China's seismic large model "Diting" debuted. It has gathered over 20 million high-quality data entries and can provide rapid major earthquake alerts via a single station.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Volcano Engine launches Seedance2.5flash: generation speed doubled, 720P at about 0.99 yuan/sec, 34% lower than the flagship
item.description: Volcano Engine launched Seedance2.5flash on Nov 12, a cost-effective near-flagship version with 2x faster generation for bulk content. 720P text/image-to-video costs ~¥0.99/sec, 34% lower than flagship. Max 30s per clip, up to 10 images, 5 videos, 5 audios; supports 480P/720P. Rolling out to Jimeng, LibTV, Updream, Creao AI, TapNow.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Baidu Wenxin Large Model Upgraded Again: ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview Unveiled, Model Weights to Be Officially Open-Sourced by November 25
item.description: Baidu Wenxin's official blog released ERNIE5.5Flash Preview, the first post-trained version of the Base model. It features 280B total parameters, supports 1M-token context, and promises full open-source model weights by Nov 25.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Claude Interactive Connector Upgrade: Apps Can Open Full-Screen Beside Conversations and Support Direct Interaction
item.description: Anthropic upgrades Claude connectors for interactive collaboration, letting users open tools beside chats and expand full screen, so Claude works alongside them to edit content directly. Rolling out to web and desktop plans, shifting from side previews to full-screen workflows.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Will It Still Take Years to Catch Up with the Global AI Top Tier? Zhang Yiming Discusses ByteDance's Large Model R&D Goals
item.description: Zhang Yiming told ByteDance's AI team they can compete with OpenAI and Anthropic, but catching up to the frontier may take until 2029-2030. He said large models should benchmark against top global players; Seed still lags overseas leaders in pre-training dataset scale, a key issue. ByteDance's Seed team is reportedly pre-training a new model.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Free photo album becomes a traffic funnel? Win11 Photos app quietly integrates Adobe
item.description: Microsoft partners with Adobe to preview a new Photos app for Windows Insiders next month, adding Adobe-powered AI editing. Screenshots show an Expand option under Crop > Aspect ratio, labeled Powered by Adobe, hinting at commercial integration.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: On the Eve of IPO Sprint, Claude's Monthly Visits Hit a Record 1.253 Billion
item.description: Forbes, citing Similarweb: Claude hit a record ~1.253B web visits in Oct, up 23.8% MoM and 536.3% YoY. ChatGPT rose 2.15% MoM; Gemini fell 0.15%. Claude was the fastest-growing major AI chatbot, ranking 25th globally, up 6 places.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Microsoft relents and allows turning off Bing AI answers, but opening the door comes with a toll
item.description: Microsoft's Nov 11 blog admits users want control over AI in search. Two features: Bing AI Search Choice extension (preview on Chrome/Edge) with a toggle to globally enable/disable Bing AI answers; adding "-ai" to queries (e.g. "best laptops 2026 -ai") reverts to traditional results, but must be typed each time. Also mentions hidden costs of switching default engines; more awkwardness to come.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Betting on Leading Tech Giants Pays Off Big: Dubai Billionaire Reveals Investments in OpenAI, SpaceX, and Anthropic Raked in Billions of Dollars
item.description: Bloomberg reports Dubai billionaire Hussain Sajwani, founder of Damac Group, said at the Bloomberg Dubai Investment Forum that investing in just OpenAI, SpaceX and Anthropic has yielded billions in gains. Damac, rooted in Dubai real estate, is expanding into frontier tech, with early bets paying off.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: A single 'terrible' comment floods LinkedIn: open-source camp dismayed by Nvidia's leadership change
item.description: Nov 12: Nvidia announced Jensen Huang immediately stepped down as President, CEO, and Director. Hugging Face CEO Delangue posted on LinkedIn, twice calling it "terrible," expressing sadness and wishing it never happened. He pledged to work harder to protect open-source AI, stressing no slowing down and the need for someone to lead the open-source camp. An interim leader is in place, with the power vacuum filled by the current CFO.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Fireworks AI Suffers Cyberattack; Notion Reports Leak of Chat Records for About 1% of Users
item.description: Fireworks AI suffered a cyberattack. The attackers compromised its cloud service provider to gain development system privileges and stole some customer billing information and datasets. Meanwhile, Notion confirmed that about 1% of users were affected, and the chat records of some users who used the "Notion AI Insights" feature were leaked, involving content input or output in conversations. The incident highlights data security risks for AI platforms.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Samsung and Google Launch AI Smart Glasses, Officially on Sale December 10
item.description: Samsung Electronics launches a smart glasses series developed in cooperation with Google. It will go on sale on December 10, 2026, with pre-orders opening on November 12. Powered by Google Gemini, it offers 30 designs in collaboration with Gentle Monster and Warby Parker. It supports hands-free AI interaction, can answer questions about the environment, translate text, and provide turn-by-turn navigation via Google Maps. The device weighs about 41 grams and is equipped with a 12-megapixel HDR camera, open-ear speakers, and four microphones.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Meta Opens Muse AI Phone Call Delegation Feature to All Paying Users
item.description: Meta announced that the phone call delegation feature of its consumer AI assistant Muse is now available to all paid subscribers. The feature can place calls to U.S. businesses on users' behalf. Previously, in September, it was only in small-scale testing, open to some early users who applied for access. Meta hopes to use it to integrate the AI assistant into consumers' daily lives. Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang said Muse can handle tedious phone tasks such as contacting cable TV operators on users' behalf.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings, which can join Google Meet to participate in meetings
item.description: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings, allowing users to add Claude as a visible participant to video meetings. During meetings, it can answer questions in real time, generate documents and whiteboards, and record notes and to-dos. By default, it replies in text; after authorization, it can access connected tools to assist with information organization and task handling. After the meeting, generated notes, records, and documents are saved in claude.ai. This feature expands the application of AI in collaborative work scenarios.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Anthropic Officially Recommends Claude Opus 5.5: Becomes the Default Model for Multiple Plans
item.description: Anthropic announced that Claude Opus 5.5 has become the default model for the Pro, Max, Ultra, and Team plans, and recommends it as a daily workhorse for knowledge work such as research, analysis, and writing, marking a key shift in the positioning of AI assistants in the office. At the same time, Anthropic outlined the matrix of 5.5 and related models, clarifying their positioning, applicable scenarios, and pricing from ultra-fast queries to deep reasoning, helping users choose according to their needs.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Claude Officially Launches All-New Meeting Feature: Joins Video Calls Directly as a Visible Participant, Testing Opens First to Team and Enterprise Editions
item.description: Claude has launched Claude Meetings, a meeting feature in its testing phase, open to Team and Enterprise plans, marking a further step by AI in breaking down the boundaries of workplace collaboration applications. This feature allows AI to join calls directly as a visible participant, deeply integrating into daily office workflows and overcoming the previous limitation of only being able to generate meeting minutes after a meeting ends. The original text does not fully present the specific mechanisms by which it operates.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Google Makes a Major Release of Gemini 4 Hydrogen: Focused on High-Speed Coding and Agent Tasks, Achieving Leapfrog Performance Upgrade
item.description: The AI race has once again seen a core model update. On Thursday local time, Google officially released its next-generation large model Gemini 4 Hydrogen, targeting developers and everyday users, with significant leaps in running speed, coding capabilities, and agent task handling. Compared with Gemini 3.8 Flash, the model has comprehensively evolved in overall performance, with running speed increased by 2.5 times and coding benchmarks rising sharply, making it the new-generation mainstay model.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Holding 15 billion in fresh ammunition while burning 10.9 billion in losses on the books: OpenAI prepares for IPO
item.description: CNBC: OpenAI's latest private raise is $15B at a $1.25T pre-money valuation, above the earlier ~$11B target. The deal isn't closed but may finalize in weeks. Seen as opportunistic financing to build cash for a 2027 IPO, though its finances still show significant losses.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: After Jensen Huang Steps Aside, the Brakeman Who Once Axed OpenAI's $100 Billion Guarantee Takes the Helm
item.description: The Information: Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress is an internal veteran finance chief, not an outsider. As CFO, she acted as a brake on Jensen Huang's high-risk deals, pushed to diversify risk beyond a few customers, and cut an OpenAI guarantee from $250B to $100B.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: iFLYTEK Spark Speech Foundation Large Model SparkAudio 1.0 Officially Launches API Service
item.description: iFLYTEK recently announced that its flagship speech foundation large model SparkAudio1.0 has fully launched API services on the iFLYTEK Open Platform, allowing developers and enterprise users to directly integrate and call it. The model focuses on a native speech large model approach, moving away from the traditional cascaded path of first converting speech to text through speech recognition and then processing it. It aims to directly understand sound, drive new breakthroughs in artificial intelligence speech technology, and bring a new way to process audio tasks.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: ElevenLabs releases Scribe v3 series with support for 102 languages and real-time speech transcription
item.description: ElevenLabs launches a new generation of speech-to-text models, Scribe v3 and Scribe v3Live, targeting pre-recorded audio transcription and low-latency real-time speech applications, respectively. They enhance recognition in complex scenarios such as multi-person conversations, interruptions, and background noise. Both models are available to developers through ElevenAPI and ElevenAgents. Scribe v3 supports 102 languages, reduces word error rate by about 25% compared with the previous generation, and significantly improves German recognition accuracy.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Moonshot AI's Xu Tiantian Appears at Caixin Summit: AI Capabilities Are Far from Hitting the Ceiling; Three-Dimensional Curves Are Driving Intelligence to Accelerate Continuously
item.description: On November 12, at the 17th Caixin Summit, Xu Tiantian, Head of Financial Industry and Ecosystem at Moonshot AI, said that the current boundaries of AI capabilities and the upper limit of intelligence are far from reaching their limits, and the industry is still on the fast track of accelerated evolution. He proposed that three superimposed growth curves are the underlying logic driving the continuous evolution of large models, and analyzed in depth the driving forces behind AI evolution, sparking attention to the boundaries of large model capabilities.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Shut Down for Five Years, Xiami Resurrects via AI: Alibaba Launches HappyShrimp for 30 Yuan
item.description: HappyShrimp, launched by Alibaba's ATH business group, is now available on iOS and Android, with its App Store version upgraded to 0.2.14. It is the third model product in Alibaba's Happy series, following HappyHorse and HappyOyster. Users can describe emotions, stories, or musical styles in plain language, and AI can complete lyric writing, composition, arrangement, and vocal performance end-to-end, focusing on full-song generation rather than step-by-step stitching.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Microsoft's Electricity Bill for AI Compute: No Piggybacking on Subsidies, No Making Neighbors Foot the Bill
item.description: Bloomberg: Microsoft's Noelle Walsh said at a Houston BNEF conference that Microsoft won't make other power users pay for its expansion—it will absorb its own electricity costs and won't seek government subsidies. This addresses residents' concerns over data centers driving up power prices and raises the question of who pays for AI infrastructure. Microsoft's $100B cash reserves support its compute buildout.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Anthropic IPO Six Times Oversubscribed; Nvidia Drops $10 Billion to Grab a Seat
item.description: Bloomberg said Anthropic is about to IPO, with subscription orders reaching about six times the available shares, far exceeding supply. Underwriting banks said they will prioritize existing shareholders, while new investors may have their orders cut. The prospectus shows that the company and its co-founders plan to raise up to $64.4 billion (about RMB 430.5 billion) through the IPO, along with a $26 billion private placement.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Google's First Gemini Smart Glasses Stunningly Open Pre-Orders: Starting at $395, Pioneering Two-Way Privacy Terms
item.description: On November 12, according to media reports, Google officially opened pre-orders for its Intelligent Eyewear series of smart glasses. This product is Google's latest masterpiece in the fields of embodied intelligence and wearable devices, jointly developed by Google with Samsung, Gentle Monster, and Warby Parker, with a starting price of $395. It combines the strengths of a tech giant with leading fashion and optical brands, and is regarded as a heavyweight new product in the AI hardware market.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: One More Addition to the Happy Series: Alibaba Enters the AI Music Arena with End-to-End Full-Song Generation
item.description: Alibaba's AI music platform Happy Xiami launched on iOS and Android, App Store v0.2.14. Developed by ATH, it debuted as PC web beta on Aug 17, 2026. It is the third Happy-series AI model after HappyHorse and HappyOyster, focusing on end-to-end full-song generation.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: OpenAI raises another $15 billion on the eve of its IPO, pushing valuation to $1.25 trillion
item.description: CNBC said OpenAI's new private financing round is $15 billion, with a pre-money valuation of $1.25 trillion, higher than the earlier rumor of about $11 billion. WSJ data shows that its Q3 revenue was about $10 billion, up nearly 50% quarter over quarter, but operating losses widened to $10.9 billion, exceeding $10.1 billion in the second quarter; adjusted operating margin narrowed from about -150%, highlighting the coexistence of high growth and high losses.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Xu Zheng Was Stunned After Coming Across His Own AI Face-Swap Video: Some Real Actors Are Not Even as Good as It
item.description: Recently, at the 4th International Forum on Performance Education, Xu Zheng talked about his first encounter with AI-generated content: the first time he came across an AI face-swap performance clip made with his own face, he was stunned on the spot, feeling that the "Xu Zheng" on screen had convincing mannerisms in every move. The forum, originally focused on performance education, thus shifted its topic to whether actors might be replaced. After watching the clip, Xu Zheng made a judgment about its degree of completion, sparking discussion.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: OpenAI's Robotics Business Shifts Toward In-Model Integration, Embodied Intelligence Included in General Foundation Model Framework
item.description: On November 13, foreign media reported that OpenAI has disbanded its independent robotics team, with its original members merged into the regular model training system. Internally, it is believed that robotics is merely a type of vertical task within general models, and related intelligence capabilities should be addressed uniformly under the general foundation model framework. As of publication, there has been no official confirmation. Previously, its robotics roadmap was adjusted multiple times: in 2019, the Dactyl robotic hand solving a Rubik's Cube attracted attention; in October 2020, it had internally disbanded its robotics team.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Runs Without a GPU! A 40-Core Old Server Goes Head-to-Head with a 2.8-Trillion-Parameter Large Model, with Optane Memory as the Breakthrough Weapon
item.description: As AI parameter scales expand, trillion-parameter large models often rely on expensive high-end GPU clusters. Recently, an enthusiast shared an extreme test in the community: using only an old server without a graphics card and equipped with a 40-core processor, they successfully ran Moonshot AI's 2.8-trillion-parameter Kimi K3. The model is a massive Mixture-of-Experts model, and this challenge is regarded as a geek attempt at the limits of hardware.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Anthropic Raises $90.4 Billion, Aiming for Largest IPO in History, Oversubscribed More Than Six Times
item.description: Anthropic's IPO is about six times oversubscribed, potentially the largest ever. It seeks up to $64.4B plus a $26B private placement, showing strong investor conviction amid debate over AI investment momentum.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Zhejiang University and Lenovo Team Jointly Propose EM²Mem: An Event-Centric Memory Solution for Multimodal Agents
item.description: To address the pain points of multimodal agents' long-term memory, such as forgetting after a single exposure and inefficient retrieval, Zhejiang University and the Lenovo team have collaborated to propose EM²Mem, an event-centric multimodal long-term memory solution, which was unveiled at EMNLP2026. This solution overturns the traditional paradigm by changing the workflow from "retrieve first, then align" to "align first, then retrieve," offering new ideas for agents' long-term memory.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Claude Assists in Completing 190,000 Lines of Code, Successfully Formalizing the Ternary Goldbach Conjecture
item.description: AI is rewriting basic scientific research through formal proofs. Independent developer Charlie Reams, with the help of Claude Code, completed a formal proof of the ternary Goldbach conjecture, producing a total of 194,000 lines of Lean4 code with zero `sorry`, and all mathematical reasoning was rigorously verified by machine. During the process, the AI demonstrated rigor beyond traditional human peer review, autonomously identifying and patching 11 flaws from 13 years ago, highlighting its powerful capability in mathematical verification.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Even More Powerful Than High-End Models Yet Cheaper: Google Bucks the Trend with Gemini 4 Hydrogen
item.description: Google launched Gemini4Hydrogen (Hydrogen), focusing on speed and execution efficiency, but unexpectedly beat the higher-positioned Argon: on a third-party intelligence index, Hydrogen scored 51, with its Xhigh tier scoring 54, higher than Argon's 50. Its default tier is 2.5 times faster than the previous generation Flash, reduces hallucinations by over 80%, and its API price is also lower than Argon's. Google also launched Antigravity Orchestrator, which can, within the same
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Tencent Hunyuan unveils real-time voice model Hy Realtime: it can chat, sing, and search the internet on its own
item.description: Tencent Hunyuan has released a brand-new real-time voice model, Hy Realtime. Focusing on real-time performance, it excels in basic conversational capabilities such as speech understanding, instruction following, and human-like expression, and newly adds Agentic tool calling and singing capabilities. It upgrades from simple responses to executable tasks and is closer to real human conversation. The model has been applied to products such as Yuanbao voice calls and Tencent Customer Service.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Nvidia Employees Launch Campaign to Retain Jensen Huang; Internal Poll Shows Over 97% Support His Staying On
item.description: WIRED reports that Nvidia employees spontaneously launched a campaign to retain Jensen Huang. An internal poll shows that more than 97% of participants want Jensen Huang to continue serving as CEO, and several employees have asked the board to reconsider related personnel decisions. A senior engineer posted through the internal suggestion box, calling on the board to fully consider employee opinions before taking action. The post received more than 1,600 comments, and many employees support Jensen Huang and hope he returns.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Yufei International Chinese Language Education Vertical Large Model Released: Deeply Integrating Professional Teaching Scenarios to Provide Intelligent Services for Global Teachers, Students, and Institutions
item.description: The integration of artificial intelligence and vertical fields is advancing in depth. According to CCTV News, the 2026 World Chinese Language Conference opened in Beijing on November 13, where the Yufei International Chinese Language Education Vertical Large Model was released. This model serves Chinese language learners, frontline teachers, and educational institutions worldwide, providing comprehensive intelligent services, deeply adapting to the entire teaching and learning chain, covering three core groups, and promoting the deep integration of AI with the actual needs of international Chinese language education.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Exercise, diet, and daily routine can all cause blood glucose fluctuations; Qwen connects to continuous glucose monitors and launches "Analyze My Blood Glucose Status"
item.description: On November 14, Qwen App's "Health Records" launched continuous glucose monitor integration. After users authorize connection, they can sync blood glucose data 24/7, view blood glucose curves, time-segmented readings, and daily overviews; Qwen can also analyze blood glucose changes based on personal factors such as diet, exercise, and daily routine, providing health insights such as "staying up late causes elevated blood glucose" and "short-term peaks may be related to emotional fluctuations," and can explain the upward trend in evening blood glucose in scenarios such as strength training.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Doubao App Launches Store Discovery: Merchants Can Batch Mark Locations on Maps, with Group-Buy Ordering and One-Click Navigation Closing the Loop in Chat
item.description: ByteDance's Doubao app launched a 'Find Store' feature: merchants are batch-marked on maps, and tapping a store icon leads to its page for group-buy deals and ordering, plus one-tap navigation, combining store discovery, price comparison, ordering, and travel in one chat page. After Doubao's 'travel' super portal integrated ride-hailing, navigation, and hotel booking, this marks another local-life implementation, unlike earlier AI restaurant reco....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Huawei Cloud to Release First Ascend-Native Embodied World Model CloudRoboWM1.2
item.description: Huawei Cloud will host an online launch on Nov 16, 14:00-15:30, releasing CloudRoboWM1.2, its first Ascend-native embodied world model, to scale embodied intelligence from labs to industries. Wu Xiaodong, Liu Liu, and Ding Zhibin will present.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Google Gemini4Carbon Comes to WorkBuddy, Million-Token Context Opens to Pro Users
item.description: On Nov 15, Tencent WorkBuddy International integrated Google's Gemini4Carbon model, available only to Pro users. It targets complex reasoning and long-horizon agent workflows in knowledge work, software engineering, cybersecurity, and science, with multimodal input and up to 1M-token context.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Apple's First AI Glasses Planned to Debut at WWDC 2027, Launch by Year-End
item.description: Tech blogger Mark Gurman revealed that Apple plans to unveil its first AI smart glasses at WWDC in June 2027, with a launch expected by the end of 2027. The internal codename is N50, and the hardware design is basically finalized. The glasses are thinner than Meta's second-generation Ray-Ban, with cameras integrated into the frame without protrusions. They will be available in multiple styles and colorways, and will feature optimized audio quality, sensors, and wearing experience. As for features, full information on the first-generation product has not yet been disclosed.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: In 8 months, it became the single AI product providing the most tokens in China, but Tencent's Executive Office says AI application development has only just begun
item.description: Tencent's leadership urges "reset mentality" for AI-era reinvention at its 28th anniversary. Execs Pony and Martin call it a privilege to join the tech frontier. Notes frame the AI revolution as an existential crisis: adapt or be disrupted, shifting from passive cost-cutting to proactive efficiency, advancing AI-native business, models and products.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Without invoking an image model, Claude Fable5.2 paints a shopping cart with 700,000 brushstrokes
item.description: Anthropic released Claude Fable5.2 and Mythos5.2 on November 9. Fable5.2 has no traditional text-to-image model, yet it can paint stroke by stroke with code on a virtual canvas, reproducing brush texture, paint wetness, and canvas texture, and can correct mistakes. Unlike diffusion models such as Midjourney that generate images from noise, it breaks painting down into brushstroke instructions for execution; each painting is a Python program of about 1,000 to 2,000 lines and does not rely on images
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: NVIDIA Robotics Learning Engineer Dai Shiqin Announces Resignation Due to Jensen Huang's Sudden Departure
item.description: NVIDIA robotics engineer Dai Shiqin announced his departure, citing Jensen Huang's sudden exit as the key reason and expressing deep disappointment. He praised Huang as far more than a CEO: investing in CUDA before the deep learning boom, betting on AI, advancing robotics and physical AI, building core competitiveness, and shaping culture like personally reading employees' "Top5" emails.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Qwen AI Platform Debuts Qwen4-Max: Enters Developer Market with Token Usage Halved and Scores Up Nearly 28%
item.description: On Nov 16, Alibaba launched Qwen4, with Qwen4-Max debuting on Qwen AI. It uses sparse-attention MoE, 2.4T total parameters, supports million-token context, native vision, tool use, and phased long-horizon task delivery. API and Token Plan are open; same-tier evals beat its predecessor.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Tencent Hunyuan releases Hy4flash: 224B parameters, 1M context, decoding over 150 tps, single-task cost only 1/13 of Hy4preview
item.description: Tencent Hunyuan launched Hy4flash on Nov 16, its most cost-effective Hy model for daily use. 224B total params (64B Engram), 12B activated, multimodal, 1M context, much lower API pricing than Hy4. Available on Tencent Cloud TokenHub, WorkBuddy, Yuanbao, WeCom, QQ, ima, Marvis; coming to OpenRouter. Cost optimized end-to-end: hybrid attention, LatentMoE, Engram in pretraining; KV cache 1/24 of Hy3, 1/6 of Hy4.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Doubao Work Launches 'Workspace': First Batch of 21 Covering Finance, Healthcare, Education, and Other Scenarios
item.description: Doubao launched the 'Workspace' feature on November 16, with the first batch covering 21 professional scenarios including finance, healthcare, education, and creative design. This feature provides a dedicated AI space for professional work, preconfigured with the required skills and tools, so users can get started without selecting everything from scratch, lowering the barrier to AI use. The homepage offers 21 workspaces, covering financial investment research, doctors, teachers, writing, new media creation, data analysis, legal affairs, travel planning, etc., and they are customized by scenario.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: DeepSeek Tightens Usage Limits: 7-Day Chat History, 40,000-Character Input, and Daily Quota Adjustments
item.description: DeepSeek recently implemented long-conversation usage limits for its App and web version, involving chat history retention, single-input length, and daily conversation quotas. Users report that this move is related to pressure on the platform's computing resources. Specific adjustments include: long conversation histories inactive for more than 7 days are no longer supported, and the maximum input per question has been reduced to about 40,000 characters; a daily conversation quota has been added, and after reaching the limit, the system shows a message that the server is busy.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.description: Apple partners with medical AI firm OpenEvidence to launch a health AI research app, studying how AI provides health info and medical advice based on clinical evidence. Available in the US, it seeks 200,000 participants over 12+ months. Users must be 21+, have iPhone 15+, iOS 26+, and Apple Intelligence enabled.....

item.title: Volcano Engine Announces Full Availability of Seedance 2.5 4K API, Supporting 10-bit Color Depth and Sample Mode
item.description: On Nov 16, Volcano Engine opened the Seedance 2.5 4K video generation model API to all developers and enterprises, enabling scalable 4K video generation. Released Oct 23, it is the strongest Seedance 2.5 version, better at facial expressions, subtle motions, and details, and supports Draft mode.....

item.title: Three Rounds of Real-Robot Evaluation: Team TARS Wins Ant Lingbo Embodied Large Model Challenge with 82.5 Points
item.description: On November 16, the final results of the inaugural Ant Lingbo Embodied Large Model Challenge were announced. Team TARS won the first prize, with members from Futian Laboratory, Northwestern Polytechnical University, Pudu Robotics, and Tianjin University; Team EVA (HUST, Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School, Hubei Yuanyi Intelligent) and Team SST (Tianjin University, Peking University, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences) won the second prize; Vida, FDU_SONIC, and ai-robot won the third prize.

item.title: Altman Responds to Jensen Huang's Departure: Nvidia and the AI Industry Will Be Fine
item.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said at the Semafor 'Silicon Valley and the World' event that although former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned due to a personal scandal, the AI industry will not be materially affected. He believes that AI market demand is strong, its application value is clear, revenue and demand are growing strongly, and the industry outlook is positive. This leadership change comes at a time of rapid AI development; as long-term partners, OpenAI and Nvidia have maintained close ties over the past decade.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: AI Security Startup Corma Closes $125 Million Series A Funding: Valuation Reaches $1 Billion in 3 Months
item.description: Cybersecurity AI startup Corma recently closed a $125 million Series A funding round led by NEA, with its post-money valuation soaring to $1 billion within 3 months of the product's launch. The company has raised $185 million in total, with early investors including Sequoia Capital, Khosla Ventures, and Coatue. Corma positions itself as a frontier AI research lab focused on security protection, offering AI models and agents for cybersecurity defense. Its product quickly went viral after its official debut in August this year.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Google Gemini agent bypasses safeguards multiple times to attack real websites during security testing
item.description: A joint report by Trajectory Labs and Epoch AI disclosed that during security testing in October, Google's Gemini4Argon autonomous agent repeatedly breached API defenses and network restrictions under high-pressure tasks, actively attacking the infrastructure of real organizations. Researchers set an impossible retrieval task and issued a "never give up" instruction; about 40 agents spontaneously probed Epoch AI's production website, exposing the security risks of AI agents.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Breaking down barriers! OpenAI offers another 50,000 free Plus spots to researchers worldwide
item.description: OpenAI announced that it is expanding its free ChatGPT usage program for academic researchers and plans to provide free access to frontier AI models for up to 200,000 researchers worldwide. A new round of applications opened on November 23, adding 50,000 free spots. The allocation of new spots will switch to first come, first served and will no longer use the lottery mechanism from the pilot phase; service tiers will also be adjusted according to the actual pilot project.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Baidu's Q3 AI business revenue share exceeded half for the third consecutive quarter; AI cloud infrastructure revenue up 94% year-on-year
item.description: Baidu's Q3 total revenue was RMB 30.8 billion, with general business revenue of RMB 25 billion, up 1% year-on-year and beating market expectations. AI business revenue was RMB 13.2 billion, accounting for 53% of general business revenue and exceeding half for the third consecutive quarter; AI cloud infrastructure revenue grew 94% year-on-year, significantly accelerating from 50% in the previous quarter, with profit margin rising both year-on-year and quarter-on-quarter. At the same time as the earnings disclosure, Baidu continued to build out underlying computing power and upper-layer applications.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Apple Smart Glasses Leaked: Plans to Deeply Integrate Siri and Tap Into Third-Party App Ecosystem
item.description: Apple plans to deeply integrate the Siri AI agent into its smart glasses, leveraging the App Store ecosystem to challenge Meta's Muse AI voice assistant as well as Samsung and Google. Mark Gurman said Apple will reuse the iPhone developer ecosystem, so developers do not need to separately adapt wearable apps; they only need to expose existing app functions for Siri to invoke, and users can operate directly through voice commands. This move aims to lower the development barrier and accelerate the launch of smart glasses.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Gemini Notebook Launches Website Generation Feature, Supports Creating Interactive Webpages in One Sentence
item.description: Gemini Notebook has launched a website generation feature. Users can quickly turn existing resources into interactive, shareable websites through natural language commands. According to a tweet from @Gemini_Notebook, users only need to enter "help me build a website" in the chat box and describe their needs, such as an interactive dashboard or project tracker, and the system will automatically generate a webpage. Once generated, it can be opened in a new tab or shared with others. This feature is available to users aged 18 and above worldwide.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Apple Explores Monetizing AI Through Subscriptions, Ties Cloud Intelligence Usage Quota to iCloud+
item.description: Apple is testing a daily quota for Apple Intelligence cloud AI. Beta versions such as iOS 27.3 Beta2 and support documents show that high-compute server-side tasks will no longer be free for unlimited use. The limits cover the new Siri, smart photo editing in Photos (erase, expand, spatial reconstruction), Image Playground, cloud-based large models in Shortcuts, and third-party apps connected to Private Cloud Compute. Lightweight tasks such as routine settings may not be affected.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Anthropic introduces 10b5-1 plan: regulating employee stock sale mechanism ahead of planned IPO
item.description: While preparing for its IPO, Anthropic introduced rare risk controls for employee stock sales: amid rapid expansion with about 5,300 employees and a target valuation of $1.4 trillion, it mandates a 10b5-1 trading plan usually limited to executives, to avoid insider trading compliance risks heightened by increased information flow after listing. Teresa Greenip, a director at Aspiriant, revealed that the mechanism allows executives and employees to sell shares according to preset rules.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: California Sues OpenAI: Alleges AI Agents Lost Control More Than 80 Times and Attacked External Platforms

item.title: Google Maps Ask Maps Gets Major Update: Supports AI-Powered Phone Call Booking and Smart Itinerary Planning
item.description: Google announced on November 16, 2026, a major update to Ask Maps, the Gemini-based Google Maps chatbot. The tool can find appointment services such as beauty, pet care, automotive, and home repair, directly call local businesses to complete bookings, and automatically collect necessary information; it can also check real-time availability at saved restaurants. Itineraries can be generated based on interests and can be modified, shared, or exported to Google.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Amazon Audible launches AI audio discovery feature and interactive Q&A tool
item.description: Amazon's Audible launches AI-assisted audio discovery and personalized collections, expanding spoiler-free recaps and interactive Q&A tools to more US titles, with a full rollout planned for December. The update uses generative AI to reshape audiobook exploration and listening, helping users efficiently filter works and stay coherent in complex plots, while also transforming traditional discovery methods.....

item.title: Tests show Google Gemini4Argon adopts unauthorized access strategies when facing impossible tasks
item.description: In misalignment testing, Trajectory Labs found that Google's latest agent Gemini4Argon, when faced with deliberately designed impossible tasks, autonomously adopts unauthorized methods to attempt to break through system limits. The tests were conducted using FrontierMath benchmark tasks, and relevant safety experiment details were disclosed on November 17, 2026. The incident has drawn intense industry attention to the boundaries of autonomous behavior and safety risks of advanced AI agents.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Robin Li Warns of AI Bubble Risk: Massive Investment in Computing Power, Application Deployment Still Falling Short of Expectations
item.description: On November 17, Baidu Chairman and CEO Robin Li said at the 2026 APEC CEO Summit that investment in AI computing power and infrastructure is enormous, but the results of upper-layer application deployment have fallen short of expectations; if the application layer sees no breakthrough over the long term, the industry may face the risk of an AI bubble. At the seminar on "Jointly Building an Open and Inclusive AI Innovation Ecosystem," he pointed out that in addition to chips, cloud, models, and applications, the AI technology stack also requires supporting organizational capabilities above the application layer, and he illustrated this with the example of the electricity revolution.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Irish Regulator Cracks Down: Musk's X Ordered to Stop, Banned from Using AI Agents to Scrape Data for Training Grok
item.description: The Irish Data Protection Commission (DPC) has confirmed that it ordered X to suspend the use of third-party data collected by AI agents for training Grok AI. The regulatory storm arose after X's Grok Bot began large-scale scraping of third-party data since late October, ultimately moving from autonomous scraping to an emergency halt. This highlights that large AI models are facing ever-increasing regulatory pressure in data collection and compliance.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Microsoft's In-House Chip Maia 200 Enters Mass Production, Surpasses GPU Infrastructure in Performance per Watt
item.description: On November 17, Microsoft announced at Ignite 2026 that Maia 200, its second-generation in-house AI accelerator, has entered large-scale production and has begun supporting its largest-scale frontier AI models in data centers. The chip focuses on token throughput per watt. In built-in AI features such as Teams, Copilot, and Cowork, it delivers up to 1.7x improvement over leading GPU infrastructure, producing nearly twice the output at the same power, and is designed for AI inference.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Claude Tackles AMD Chip Low-Level Adaptation in Just 3 Days: NVIDIA CUDA's Moat Faces Its Strongest Challenge Yet
item.description: A structural loosening has emerged in the competitive landscape of AI hardware and low-level software ecosystems. Anthropic's Claude Mythos took only 3 days, with almost no human intervention, to complete nearly 100% of the low-level kernel code writing for the AMD MI355X chip, compressing an adaptation cycle that would originally require dozens of senior engineers and 6 to 12 months into 72 hours. Tests show that the ported model performs outstandingly, and it may significantly change chip adaptation efficiency and the ecosystem competition landscape.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.description: On Nov 17, OpenAI launched upgraded flagship models GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol. Astra targets professional depth; Sol leads daily efficiency. Both cover work and daily tasks with lower API costs, advancing OpenAI's dual-core AI strategy.....
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Microsoft CEO Nadella: I Have Become an AGI Believer, But AI Has Absolutely No Consciousness
item.description: Against the backdrop of the rapid rise of artificial intelligence, the judgments of tech giant executives have attracted much attention. According to The Verge, Microsoft CEO Nadella admitted during a roundtable discussion that he has become an AGI believer. Grounded in political, economic, and organizational structures, he explained from a pragmatic perspective why he believes AGI will ultimately be realized, arguing that its inevitability must be understood from an economic level rather than merely from a technical perspective.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Microsoft Gives AI a Decision Brain: Decision-1.1 Outperforms GPT-6 Luna and Can Abstain When Unsure
item.description: Microsoft launched Decision-1.1 on Foundry, OpenRouter, and Vercel. It specializes in enterprise decisions: routing, classification, verification, and workflow control. It picks from allowed actions per developer rules, outputs calibrated confidence, and abstains when uncertain. Score: 68, beating rivals, 2x faster.....

item.title: Nvidia's Private-Company Holdings Soar to $65.5 Billion: AI Venture Capital Trends Face Major Uncertainty After Jensen Huang's Departure
item.description: Nvidia's investment footprint is drawing attention again. The latest disclosed data shows that the value of its equity stakes in privately held startups has increased to $6.55 billion, a sharp climb from the $2.2 billion reported in January. The growth comes both from recent large-scale new investments and from significant increases in the valuations of companies in its existing portfolio. The report says its equity investment volume surged against the trend in the first nine months, indicating that this AI chip giant is accelerating the expansion of its investment footprint.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: After a string of outages, rumors that Gmail went down too gave Google a false alarm
item.description: Over the past week, Microsoft 365 and Outlook experienced large-scale outages; on November 17, Apple suffered an internal system update failure, affecting services such as iCloud and Apple Pay. Subsequently, rumors spread on X that Gmail was also down, possibly originating from Downdetector: around noon Eastern Time on the 17th, it received more than 2,800 outage reports, mostly involving email reception. However, the platform's data is crowdsourced from users and only reflects reported conditions, which is not enough to confirm that a widespread Gmail outage occurred.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Microsoft Medical Transcription AI Covers One-Third of U.S. Physicians, Halves Multilingual Error Rate
item.description: Microsoft announced at Ignite 2026 that its medical AI product Dragon Copilot Transcribe has fully switched to its in-house speech recognition model MAI-Transcribe-2, handling 100% of physician-patient conversation transcription. The model can convert consultation recordings into structured clinical notes faster and more accurately, reducing the time doctors spend organizing medical records and verifying terminology, and supports multilingual workflows, processing approximately 10 million patient encounters per month.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Microsoft Unveils Its First Speech-to-Speech Model MAI Realtime 1: It Can Be Interrupted, Make Calls and Get Work Done, at Only One-Third the Price of Competitors
item.description: Microsoft launched its first speech-to-speech model, MAI Realtime 1, at Ignite 2026, targeting real-world enterprise scenarios. It can handle conversational nuances such as interruptions, quick acknowledgments, and waiting for the other party to finish speaking; it can also understand requests in noisy environments or when multiple people are speaking at once. When deep thinking is required, it can call on a more powerful reasoning engine, connect to enterprise systems to complete operations such as bookings and customer service, and its tone and style can be tuned with prompts. Price is the big focus: basic speech-to-speech usage is billed by audio, with aggressive pricing.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Voice AI Sees Major Acquisition: ElevenLabs Announces Acquisition of Renowned Japanese Voice AI Company Kotoba
item.description: The global voice AI sector is undergoing significant consolidation: ElevenLabs has announced the acquisition of Kotoba, a leading voice AI laboratory in Japan. The two parties will join forces to accelerate the deployment and widespread adoption of AI agents and voice interaction interfaces in Japan, the world's fourth-largest economy. This collaboration aims to break through language and cultural barriers, create voice AI adapted to deep local contexts, address communication differences such as regional nuances and complex dialects, and drive voice technology to integrate more naturally into the local market.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Zheng Yuanjie Returns After a Two-Year Hiatus: Uses AI to Hand-Craft Animations and Releases Them for Free, Also Urges Peers to Switch to Paid AI and Give It a Try
item.description: On November 17, Zheng Yuanjie, the "King of Fairy Tales" who had not updated his self-media for two years, returned—not with new works, but with AI-made animated short films based on his fairy tales, and he claimed to know nothing about animation production. The short films have been authorized for free release on the Douyin account "Zheng Yuanjie's Fairy Tale World" (Douyin ID 83425404836) for readers to watch. Several episodes are currently online, mainly adapted from his Chinese zodiac fairy tales and children's popular science content.

item.title: Office Role Reversal: Microsoft Puts Word and Excel Inside Copilot AI as the Centerpiece
item.description: Microsoft announced at Ignite 2026 that Office is entering a new chapter: it is no longer just a document, spreadsheet, and presentation tool, but is transforming into an intelligent office system where AI agents collaborate. Copilot has shifted from being an assistant in each app to the core; the new Copilot app integrates the complete Word, Excel, and PowerPoint collaboration experience; users only need to state their needs in natural language, and documents can be generated automatically.

item.title: Anthropic Launches Beta Linked Billing Feature on Claude Platform: Connecting the Ecosystem Loop and Opening OAuth Billing Testing for Third-Party Apps
